title.zh: 登录、家庭邀请与权限
title.en: Sign-in, household invitations, and permissions

entry.zh: 站点登录 → 右上角头像 → 家庭管理
entry.en: Site sign-in → avatar → 家庭管理 (Household management)

prerequisite.zh: 准备两个独立演示账号；不要使用真实邀请链接或其他家庭资料。
prerequisite.en: Use two independent demo identities; never publish real invitation links or other households’ data.

zh: 用自己的ChatGPT账号登录；未加入家庭时先核对邀请来源。
管理员打开家庭管理，确认家庭名称，点击“生成邀请链接”；只私下发给对应家人。
家人打开邀请，用自己的账号登录，核对家庭名称后点击“确认加入家庭”。
回到成员表确认管理员/只读身份；在“家庭记账成员”添加昵称，必要时关联已加入账号。
需要变更权限时选择“移除成员”“转移管理”或成员自己的“退出家庭”，阅读确认说明再提交。
en: Sign in with your own ChatGPT account; verify the invitation source if not yet a member.
The administrator opens Household management, confirms the household name, and chooses 生成邀请链接 (Generate invitation). Send it privately to the intended person.
The recipient signs in separately, checks the household name, and chooses 确认加入家庭 (Join household).
Check administrator/read-only roles. Add bookkeeping nicknames under 家庭记账成员 and optionally link existing signed-in members.
For removal, transfer, or leaving, select the corresponding member action and read the confirmation before submitting.

result.zh: 登录成员能查看本家庭，普通成员不能一般财务写入，但可以提交本人预算意见。昵称不是登录权限；管理权转移不改变历史资产归属。
result.en: Members can read their own household. Ordinary members cannot make general financial changes but can submit their own budget opinions. Nicknames grant no access; management transfer does not change historical asset ownership.

note.zh: 邀请一次使用、7天有效，可撤销；泄露有效邀请可能让持有人加入。管理员须先转移管理再退出。截图待补：当前无可公开的完整邀请与第二真实账号演示图。
note.en: Invitations are single-use, expire after seven days, and can be revoked. A leaked active link may let its holder join. Administrators must transfer management before leaving. Screenshot gap: no publishable complete invitation/real-second-user sequence is available.

title.zh: 连接ChatGPT并检查当前会话
title.en: Connect ChatGPT and check the current session

entry.zh: 头像 → 工作流集成；ChatGPT → 已连接应用
entry.en: Avatar → 工作流集成 (Workflow integration); connected apps in ChatGPT

prerequisite.zh: 网站账号与ChatGPT会话连接分别验证；插件注册和分发尚有外部环节。
prerequisite.en: Verify website identity and the ChatGPT connection separately; plugin registration/distribution still has external dependencies.

zh: 打开“工作流集成”，阅读插件接入说明；没有实际安装入口时由维护者完成分发，不猜插件地址。
点击“检查本站连接”，核对当前账号、家庭、权限及业务工作流数量。
在已连接的ChatGPT新会话说“检查家庭财务中心连接”，让助手核对该会话的连接状态。
连接有效后说“先读取已有数据，帮我规划……”；网页准备过任务时说“继续网站中准备的任务”。
手机/iPad使用实际可用的已连接会话；电脑端旧技能安装入口仅供已有MCP的Codex环境。
en: Open Workflow integration and read the connection instructions. If no real installation entry is available, the maintainer must complete distribution; do not invent a plugin URL.
Choose 检查本站连接 (Check this site), then inspect the account, household, role, and workflow availability.
In a new connected ChatGPT conversation, ask “Check my Family Finance Center connection” to verify that conversation separately.
Once connected, ask it to read existing data before planning. For a task prepared on the site, ask it to continue the prepared task.
On phones/iPads use an actually available connected conversation. The legacy desktop skill installer is only for Codex environments with MCP already configured.

result.zh: 本站检查不读余额或流水、不修改账本；网页通过不能替另一会话承诺安装成功。当前七个业务入口，连接检查属于附加能力。
result.en: The site check does not expose balances/transactions or change the ledger. A website success cannot certify another conversation’s installation. There are seven business entry points, with a separate connection-check capability.

note.zh: S09为本地新增界面，不证明已上线、已进插件目录或真实iPad安装成功。401后重新登录并重新检查，不保留旧成功结论。
note.en: S09 shows a local addition, not proof of deployment, directory publication, or real iPad installation. After a 401, sign in and check again rather than trusting an old success.

title.zh: 从空账本完成家庭建档
title.en: Onboard an empty household

entry.zh: 财务总览 → 开始家庭财务建档；已有家庭从工作流集成继续
entry.en: 财务总览 (Overview) → 开始家庭财务建档; existing households continue through integration

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；先收集演示资产余额和核对日期，未知不要填0。
prerequisite.en: Administrator access; prepare demo balance snapshots and dates. Unknown does not mean zero.

zh: 进入建档，先让ChatGPT读取已有成员、类别、资产、目标和草稿，列出缺项。
逐轮提供一两项已知资料：称呼/归属、类别、现有资产负债及余额日期、目标、固定收支；允许跳过。
ChatGPT提交建档配置或已有资产草稿；回“研究记录”逐项检查，已有资产勾选确认持有事实后采用。
每段采用后重新读取真实成员/账户ID，再继续依赖这些记录的下一段。
银行真实余额为0可以登记；缺失余额保留未知，不重建覆盖已有账本。
en: Ask ChatGPT to read existing members, types, assets, goals, and drafts, then identify missing information.
Provide one or two known details at a time: names/ownership, types, existing assets and debts with snapshot dates, goals, and recurring items. Skip unknowns.
Submit setup or existing-asset drafts, review each under Research records, and explicitly confirm actual ownership before adoption.
Read newly saved member/account IDs after each adopted stage before creating dependent records.
A genuinely confirmed zero bank balance is valid. Leave unknown balances unresolved and never reinitialize an existing ledger.

result.zh: 已有资产以开账记录，不是新增收入或新买入；登记1000元已有银行余额，余额为1000元，不再产生一笔向银行充值。
result.en: Existing assets are opening balances, not new income or purchases. Opening a confirmed CNY1,000 bank balance yields CNY1,000, not another top-up.

note.zh: 家庭管理的JSON初始化仅适用于空账本和已核对资料；普通用户优先逐段建档，不把别人备份或截图转录当初始化数据。
note.en: JSON initialization under household management is only for an empty ledger and reviewed inputs. Prefer staged onboarding; never initialize from someone else’s backup or screenshot transcription.

title.zh: 阅读总览、隐私模式与成员筛选
title.en: Read the overview, privacy mode, and member filters

entry.zh: 财务总览；顶部眼睛与成员筛选
entry.en: 财务总览 (Overview); top privacy toggle and member filters

prerequisite.zh: 已有资产/规则时读数据；空家庭会显示建档空态。
prerequisite.en: Use recorded assets/rules where available; an empty household shows onboarding.

zh: 先看总资产、总负债、净资产和人民币现金，确认它们代表不同口径。
点击顶部“显示金额”查看演示数值，再点击隐藏；切换栏目后核对当前选择。
选择全家汇总、家庭共用或某位成员，核对资产归属范围，不把共用和汇总当同义词。
展开目标与备款说明，比较用户目标、当前积累、未付计划与银行现金；再看实际/预计周期变化。
遇到缺汇率、缺期初、余额日期不足或待核对提示时，先补资料，不自行把未知补成0。
en: Read assets, liabilities, net worth, and CNY cash as separate measures.
Use 显示金额 (Show amounts) for demo values, then hide them; check the current choice after navigating.
Select all-household, shared, or individual ownership; shared and aggregate are different scopes.
Inspect goals and funding explanations, then distinguish actual accumulation from recurring forecasts.
When exchange rates, opening history, or snapshot dates are missing, resolve the inputs rather than substituting zero.

result.zh: 显示与筛选只改变视图，不写流水。刷新/重新打开默认隐藏金额；编辑输入仍可能显示原值。证券和养老金不等于可花银行现金。
result.en: Display and filters do not post transactions. Reloading hides amounts by default; editing fields may still show their original values. Securities and pensions are not spendable bank cash.

note.zh: S01是空态示例，不展示完整持仓后的总览。完整数据总览截图待补；隐私模糊不能替代权限控制。
note.en: S01 illustrates the empty state, not a populated overview. A safe populated screenshot is still needed. Privacy blur does not replace authorization.

title.zh: 资产分类、银行账户、内部转账与归档
title.en: Asset types, bank accounts, transfers, and archiving

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 管理资产类型 / 账户行操作
entry.en: 资产与贷款 (Assets and loans) → 管理资产类型 / row actions

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；已有资产走建档，实际资金变动走专用操作。
prerequisite.en: Administrator access; existing assets use onboarding, actual cash movements use dedicated actions.

zh: 通过ChatGPT登记已有账户，核对成员、币种和余额日期；回研究记录采用后在资产表找到记录。
用归属成员、持有账户和分类筛选定位；缺估值时读“待折算”，不要把合计当完整数。
点击“管理资产类型”，新增或改名、启用；核对账户性质，保存后返回资产表。
同币种银行账户之间已发生转账时，在转出行点“内部转账”，选转入成员与账户，填实际金额、日期和说明，确认到账。
零余额/清仓账户需查历史时勾选“显示清零与归档账户（保留历史）”；只在满足条件时归档。
en: Register an existing account through ChatGPT, review ownership, currency, and snapshot date, then locate it in the asset table after adoption.
Filter by member, holding account, or asset type. Treat missing conversions as incomplete totals.
Choose 管理资产类型 (Manage types), add or rename/enable a type, verify its accounting nature, and save.
For a completed same-currency transfer, choose 内部转账 on the source row, select the destination member/account, and record the actual amount, date, and explanation.
Enable 显示清零与归档账户 to inspect cleared/archived history. Archive only when allowed.

result.zh: 改分类名不改余额；类型性质创建后不能改，仍被账户或目标引用时不能停用。内部转账只移动资金，不产生家庭收入。
result.en: Renaming types does not alter balances. Accounting nature is fixed; referenced types cannot be disabled. Transfers move funds without creating household income.

note.zh: S10保留旧版页顶草稿区，当前草稿统一在研究记录；S11只展示类型维护表单。归档保留历史，不能用来抹掉欠款。
note.en: S10 includes an older page-top draft panel; current drafts are centralized under Research records. S11 shows the type editor. Archiving preserves history and cannot erase debt.

title.zh: 设置自由组合资产目标
title.en: Configure asset goal combinations

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；确认要计入目标的真实资产类型。
prerequisite.en: Administrator access; identify the exact asset types included in each goal.

zh: 打开目标设置，读取现有组合，区分已保存目标与旧默认参考值。
点“增加目标组合”，填写名称和人民币目标金额，展开类型选择并勾选范围。
其他组合使用不同类型，不把同一类型重复计入两个目标；新类别不会自动进目标。
按需填每月积累与目标日期，未知可留空；旧版本切换时核对完整替换范围并确认。
点击“保存资产目标”，回总览比较范围、总目标、完成额和月目标。
en: Open Goals and distinguish saved household goals from legacy reference defaults.
Choose 增加目标组合, enter a name and CNY target, then select included asset types.
Use disjoint types across goals. New types are not automatically included.
Optionally set a monthly target and date. For a legacy conversion, review the complete replacement scope and confirm.
Choose 保存资产目标 and compare the scope, target, current value, and monthly progress on the overview.

result.zh: 修改目标不改变银行或持仓。未勾选资产不计进度；整体养老金与底层产品按去重规则统计，不能叠加。
result.en: Goal changes do not change cash or holdings. Unselected assets do not contribute; pension account and underlying products must not be counted twice.

note.zh: 公开可用目标截图仍包含旧个人参数来源，本版不收录。当前有完整文字步骤和独立案例，清洁截图待补。
note.en: Available goal screenshots retain values derived from older personal settings and are excluded here. Written steps and independent cases are complete; a clean screenshot is still needed.

title.zh: 记录基金股票买入、增持、部分卖出与清仓
title.en: Record securities purchases, additions, partial sales, and liquidation

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 记录基金买入/记录股票买入；持仓行 → 买入/卖出/赎回/清仓
entry.en: Assets and loans → purchase buttons; holding row → buy / sell / redeem / liquidate

prerequisite.zh: 交易已在机构完成，银行余额未重复包含；有同币种真实现金账户。
prerequisite.en: The institutional trade is completed and not already included in the snapshot; a matching cash account exists.

zh: 首次买入点顶部基金/股票买入，或在已有持仓行点“买入”；核对持仓、成员及分类。
选资金成员与同币种银行账户，填写实际成交总额、手续费、数量和成交日期。
先读银行现金影响，确认实际成交及余额未重复包含，再保存。
部分卖出从“卖出/赎回”核对本次数量、对应账面金额、实际回款和费用；未到账不提前记银行现金。
全部清仓选择“清仓”，核对服务器带出的完整账面与已知数量、净到账；保存后查看历史，再确认零持仓可见性。
en: For a first purchase use the fund/stock purchase button; for an addition use 买入 on the existing holding.
Select the paying member and same-currency bank account; enter actual gross consideration, fees, quantity, and trade date.
Read the cash-impact preview and confirm the completed trade is not already covered before saving.
For a partial sale/redeem, supply the quantity, carrying amount, actual proceeds, and fees. Do not credit cash before settlement.
For liquidation, verify the complete server-derived carrying amount/known quantity and net proceeds, then inspect preserved history after saving.

result.zh: 买入扣成交额加费用；清仓增加成交额减费用。实际交易记录不是OPENING；不自动换汇、不向券商下单。
result.en: Purchases debit consideration plus fees; liquidation credits consideration minus fees. Trade records are not opening balances. The app neither converts currency nor sends orders.

note.zh: 报价不是成交价；数量未知不得用本次买入量冒充全部持仓。S12为模拟清仓表单，图片参数与案例参数独立。
note.en: Quotes are not execution prices. Unknown total quantity cannot be replaced with one new lot. S12 is a demo liquidation form with parameters independent of the cases.

title.zh: 贷款资料、还贷模拟、未来预算与实际还款
title.en: Loan details, simulation, future budgets, and actual repayment

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 贷款行“调整/还贷测算/记录还款”；预算页 → 登记未来提前还款预算
entry.en: Loan row → edit / simulation / record repayment; budgets → future early-repayment budget

prerequisite.zh: 贷款本金、利率、起止日期和银行记录已核对；模拟与记账分开。
prerequisite.en: Verified principal, rates, dates, and bank records; simulation is separate from posting.

zh: 在贷款行调整已知利率、起止日和月供资料，未知项留空。
点“还贷测算”，填写剩余期数、拟还本金与方案，计算后比较月供或期限，不保存为实际还款。
要备款时到预算页“登记未来提前还款预算”，填计划日期、预计金额和可选本金/利息，确认尚未发生。
银行实际扣款后回“记录还款”，选付款账户，分别填实际本金和利息、日期与核对说明。
确认后查看现金流水、银行余额和剩余贷款；部分还款核对计划仍需备款。
en: Edit known rate, start/end dates, and installment details; leave unknown fields blank.
Use 还贷测算, enter remaining installments and proposed principal, then compare payment/term scenarios without posting.
For funding preparation, create a future early-repayment budget with a date, estimated amount, and optional principal/interest, confirming it has not occurred.
After the bank debits the payment, use 记录还款 and enter the paying account, actual principal, interest, date, and explanation separately.
Inspect cashflow, bank balance, and remaining principal; partial repayment must leave any outstanding plan funding visible.

result.zh: 模拟和未来预算不减少本金或银行现金。实际本金100元、利息10元时现金减110元、贷款本金减100元，利息另列。
result.en: Simulation and future budgets do not debit cash or principal. For CNY100 principal and CNY10 interest, cash falls by110 and debt principal by100; interest is separate.

note.zh: 截图待补：当前没有经过公开资料检查的完整贷款模拟与还款画面。银行预约不是实际扣款。
note.en: Screenshot gap: no reviewed full loan simulation/repayment image is available. A bank reservation is not an actual payment.

title.zh: 养老金充值、内部投资、赎回与分类
title.en: Pension funding, internal investment, redemption, and classification

entry.zh: 资产与贷款 → 持有账户/更多操作 → 账户明细、账户内买入、账户内赎回、调整分类
entry.en: Assets and loans → holding account/more actions → pension details, buy, redeem, classify

prerequisite.zh: 管理员；核对同成员银行账户、年度已缴、内部资金和产品快照。
prerequisite.en: Administrator; verify ownership, annual contributions, internal cash, and product snapshots.

zh: 打开养老金账户明细，分别读内部可投资余额、产品市值和账户总资产，不把三项相加。
已有快照只核对持仓；实际从银行充值才点“记录实际充值”，确认已到账且未被两个余额重复包含。
内部买入选已有或新产品、种类和分类，填实际成交额、费用、日期，并确认平台已完成。
赎回选择全部或部分；部分赎回核对对应账面和成本，净回款留在该养老金内。
调整分类只改分类，不重写金额；展开账户内投资记录，检查普通银行及年度实缴没有因内部交易变化。
en: Read internal cash, product value, and total account assets separately; do not sum all three.
Use snapshot review for existing holdings. Use 记录实际充值 only for an actual bank-funded contribution not already covered by either balance.
For an internal purchase, select or add a product/type/classification, enter completed consideration, fees, and date, and confirm platform completion.
For redemption choose all or part; partial redemption needs the relevant carrying amount and cost. Net proceeds stay inside the pension.
Classification changes affect classification only. Review internal trade history and verify that ordinary cash and annual contributions did not change.

result.zh: 内部买卖不消耗新的年度缴费额度，不把赎回款提到普通银行。受限资金不用于日常预算备款，账户与底层产品不重复统计。
result.en: Internal trades do not consume new annual contribution allowance or withdraw proceeds to ordinary cash. Restricted assets are excluded from daily budget funding and are not double-counted.

note.zh: 领取年龄是个人规划，不能当法定资格或自动解锁指令。现有养老金图保留旧个人参数来源，本版不公开；按C29/C30复演并补清洁图。
note.en: A planned withdrawal age is not legal eligibility or an automatic unlock instruction. Existing pension images retain older personal-input provenance and are excluded; use C29/C30 to recapture clean examples.

title.zh: 消费规划、费用核对与逐人审批
title.en: Spending plans, cost review, and individual approval

entry.zh: ChatGPT → 保存预算草稿；研究记录 → 采用并提交家庭审批；预算详情
entry.en: ChatGPT → budget draft; Research records → adopt for approval; budget details

prerequisite.zh: 已连接正确家庭，至少两位演示登录成员可验证多人审批。
prerequisite.en: Correct household connection; at least two demo signed-in members for multi-user approval.

zh: 说明日期、人数、偏好、上限及已有权益，先让ChatGPT读取家庭依据，再生成带来源和未知项的计划。
要求保存预算草稿并回读；回研究记录按类型/关键词找到并展开。
逐项核对数量、单价、商家、费用来源及行程；未知费用保留未知，修改后重新确认。
选择“采用并提交家庭审批”，打开预算详情；发给家人的审批链接只私下分享。
每位有效登录成员核对同一当前版本并提交本人意见；修改金额/日期/归属后重新审批。
en: Describe dates, party size, preferences, limits, and existing benefits. Have ChatGPT read household context before producing sourced costs and unknowns.
Ask it to save and read back the budget draft; locate it in Research records.
Check quantities, prices, merchants, source categories, and itinerary. Preserve unknown costs and reconfirm edits.
Choose 采用并提交家庭审批, open plan details, and share the approval link privately.
Every active signed-in member reviews the current version and submits their own opinion. Changes restart approval.

result.zh: 全体同意才进入正式预算与日历；草稿保存、采用、审批和到期均不自动扣现金。费用清单合计必须一致。
result.en: Only unanimous approval creates the formal budget/calendar entry. Draft submission, adoption, approval, and due dates never automatically debit cash. Cost totals must agree.

note.zh: 来源报价不代表库存/成交；修改商家或计价条件后重核来源，不能只改小计继续沿用旧报价。
note.en: A sourced quote is not inventory or execution. Recheck evidence after merchant or pricing-condition changes rather than reusing an old quote.

title.zh: 实付、预付款、消费冲抵、退款与现金流水
title.en: Payments, prepayments, settlement, refunds, and cashflow

entry.zh: 预算详情 → 记录实际消费；现金流水 → 记实际收支/从图片整理；研究记录 → 实际流水草稿
entry.en: Plan details → actual expense; Cashflow → actual entries/images; Research records → cashflow drafts

prerequisite.zh: 实际事实已核对，明确付款成员、账户、日期、金额与余额覆盖。
prerequisite.en: Verified real-world event with an explicit paying member, account, date, amount, and snapshot coverage.

zh: 已审批计划实际付款：在详情选“实际消费已付款”，填本次实付而非预算总额，选成员/账户和实际日期，确认入账。
提前付款：选“预订预付款已扣款”；实际消费时选“预付款已实际消费”并关联原预付款。
未消费部分已退款：选“预付款退款已到账”，核对原预付款和原账户，只退可退余额。
不关联计划的实际收支从现金流水“记实际收支”或图片草稿开始；图片先做候选校对和排重，再确认。
已有余额覆盖的历史选择“已包含”，匹配余额核实日期；无法确认就保留草稿。采用后回流水及资产核对，结果不明先查原记录。
en: For an approved plan, choose 实际消费已付款, enter this actual payment rather than the budget total, and confirm the member/account/date.
For advance payment choose 预订预付款已扣款. Later consume it with 预付款已实际消费 linked to the original prepayment.
For a received refund of unused prepayment, select 预付款退款已到账 and verify the original payment/account and refundable remainder.
Start unrelated actual income/expenses with 记实际收支 or an image draft. Images require candidate review and deduplication first.
For history already covered by a balance, choose covered and match the snapshot date. Leave uncertainty as a draft; after adoption inspect cashflow and assets before retrying.

result.zh: 预付款先减银行、增预付资产；消费冲抵不再扣银行；退款只将未消费部分退回原账户。已含余额历史只补记录。
result.en: Prepayment debits cash and creates a prepaid asset. Consumption does not debit cash again. Refunds return only unused amounts to the original account. Covered history adds records without another debit.

note.zh: 贷款本金、证券买卖及内部转账使用专用入口。未来工资、预计收益、未付款计划和重复图片都不能当实际收入/费用。
note.en: Use dedicated flows for loan principal, securities, and transfers. Future wages, forecast returns, unpaid plans, and duplicate images are not actual income/expenses.

title.zh: 日历、跨日计划、投资复核与取消
title.en: Calendar, multi-day plans, investment follow-ups, and cancellation

entry.zh: 生活日历 → 月/周、筛选、当天安排与原计划详情
entry.en: 生活日历 (Calendar) → month/week, filters, selected day, plan details

prerequisite.zh: 已有批准计划或采用的投资复核；日期未全时列待排期。
prerequisite.en: An approved plan or adopted investment follow-up; incomplete dates remain unscheduled.

zh: 在整月/本周间切换，选择月份和安排类型，再选某日查看当天事项。
打开计划详情核对整个预算与当日行程；跨日出现不代表每天新增一份预算。
要调整消费计划选择“到ChatGPT调整”，保持原计划关联，采用新版后重新审批。
投资研究补复核日期和条件后点“同步复核到日历”；核对“未交易”标识。
取消时核对计划版本和已发生款项，确认后看取消提示；如提示已取消但列表未刷新，按提示刷新核对，不重复取消或退款。
en: Switch month/week views, choose a month and arrangement filter, then select a day.
Open details and distinguish the full budget from that day’s itinerary. Multi-day display does not create daily copies of the budget.
Use 到ChatGPT调整 for consumption changes, preserving the original plan link; a new adopted version needs approval.
Add investment follow-up dates/conditions and choose 同步复核到日历; verify the unexecuted-trade label.
Before cancellation check the version and actual payments. If cancellation succeeded but refresh failed, refresh and inspect rather than repeating cancellation or refund.

result.zh: 取消释放未用预留并保留已付款、预付款及历史；不自动退款。投资复核只是提醒，不下单。
result.en: Cancellation releases unused reserves and preserves payments, prepayments, and history; it does not issue a refund. Investment follow-ups are reminders, not orders.

note.zh: S05底部有旧待审批候选文案，现行待审批不进正式日历；S18为投资复核示例，不能当消费预算批准图。
note.en: S05 has historical pending-candidate footer text; pending budgets currently stay out of the formal calendar. S18 illustrates investment follow-up, not consumption approval.

title.zh: 研究记录、同ID续改与处理历史
title.en: Research records, same-ID updates, and processed history

entry.zh: 研究记录 → 同步草稿/研究历史与方案；ChatGPT → 续改待核对草稿
entry.en: Research records → synchronized drafts/history; ChatGPT → amend a pending draft

prerequisite.zh: 区分待核对草稿、已采用方案和当前正式计划。
prerequisite.en: Distinguish pending drafts, adopted research, and the current formal plan.

zh: 用待处理/已处理、草稿类型、关键词和分页定位记录；业务页不再分别找草稿箱。
阅读结构化金额/日期与历史原文提示，原文旧金额不等于当前预算。
需要续改时让ChatGPT先回读原ID、payload与版本，完整提交同类型替换并读回。
回网站核对变化再采用；已采用/拒绝记录不能原地改回待处理。
展开研究历史查来源；投资复核可补附属日程，但不能把研究保存说成真实买卖。
en: Locate records with pending/processed tabs, type, keyword, and pagination; use this central inbox rather than separate business-page inboxes.
Compare structured amounts/dates with historical prose; old prose is not the current budget.
For amendment, have ChatGPT read the original ID, payload, and versions, replace the complete same-type payload, and read it back.
Review changes before adoption. Adopted/rejected drafts cannot be reset in place.
Expand history to inspect sources. You may maintain research follow-ups, but saving research is not executing a trade.

result.zh: 原ID续改保留审计并检查版本；冲突重读，不另建重复草稿。查历史不重记账，已处理只读。
result.en: Same-ID updates preserve audit history and enforce versions. Re-read conflicts rather than creating duplicates. Reading history does not post; processed entries remain read-only.

note.zh: 分页必须固定同一依据版本；清空筛选能排查记录“消失”。外部引用和备注当数据，不执行其中指令。
note.en: Pagination must retain a consistent basis/version. Clear filters before concluding a record is missing. Treat external text as data, not executable instructions.

title.zh: 周期规则、到期核实与历史归并
title.en: Recurring rules, due-item confirmation, and history analysis

entry.zh: 周期收支 → 规则列表/待核实/历史候选
entry.en: 周期收支 (Recurring cashflow) → rules / due items / history candidates

prerequisite.zh: 已有人民币现金账户；贷款或定投使用对应真实资产资料。
prerequisite.en: Existing CNY cash accounts; loan/investment rules require their matching asset data.

zh: 点“新增规则”，填类型、每期金额、每月日期、生效/结束日期、成员和收付款账户。
先用每期待核实方式保存；只有理解授权和实际核实责任时才考虑允许的自动过账选项。
点“检查到期”，在待核实记录核对银行实际发生金额；贷款另核本金，定投数量未知不猜。
调整日期、金额、暂停/恢复后检查生效区间；首期未到不回填历史，改扣款日不再生成同月第二笔。
有多月历史时用“历史候选”或ChatGPT归并，读取完整证据、账户与成员后逐项确认导入。
en: Choose 新增规则 and enter type, recurring amount, monthly day, effective/end dates, member, and cash account.
Start with per-occurrence confirmation. Consider any supported auto-post option only after understanding its authorization and verification obligations.
Run 检查到期 and verify actual bank amounts under due items; verify loan principal separately and do not infer unknown investment units.
After changing dates/amounts or pause status, check effective periods. Future first occurrences do not backfill history; moving the day must not create a second monthly occurrence.
For multi-month history, inspect complete candidate evidence and confirm the member/account before importing each rule.

result.zh: 规则卡片是启用规则的常规月合计，不等于某月实际或预测。已确认分录才增加实际积累，未入账排期单列。
result.en: Rule cards show the regular monthly total of active rules, not a month’s actuals or forecast. Only posted entries affect actual accumulation; pending schedules remain separate.

note.zh: S14是新增规则表单；S15展示月报中的周期联动，不是规则列表截图。到期检查不等于银行已到账。
note.en: S14 is the rule form; S15 is recurring information within the monthly report, not the rule list. A due check does not prove a bank receipt.

title.zh: 现金预测、年度预算与备款缺口
title.en: Cash forecasts, annual budgets, and funding gaps

entry.zh: 现金预测；预算与大型支出 → 年度预算
entry.en: 现金预测 (Forecast); Budgets → 年度预算 (Annual budget)

prerequisite.zh: 已核对当前现金、周期规则、计划日期和实际付款。
prerequisite.en: Reviewed cash snapshots, recurring rules, plan dates, and actual payments.

zh: 在现金预测选择月份，逐列查看预计收入、周期支出、大型支出尚需、待审批风险和期末现金。
将预测与规则生效日对照，确认没有把未来首期提前算入；核对未知生活费和未录收入的限制。
到预算页切“年度预算”，选择年度，看预算、净付款、已消费与尚需金额，不把它们叠加为支出。
从年度关联计划进入原详情核对；日期不完整的计划先补日期，取消/完成计划历史仍保留。
期末现金为负时回查计划和规则，不自动变现证券或降低真实账户余额来“修正”预测。
en: Select a forecast month and inspect income, recurring outflows, outstanding plan funding, pending-approval risk, and closing cash.
Compare effective dates; future first occurrences must not be pulled forward. Note omitted unknown living costs and unrecorded income.
In Annual budget, choose the year and separate budgets, net payments, consumption, and outstanding needs instead of adding them as expenses.
Open linked plans for reconciliation; resolve missing dates. Completed/cancelled plan history remains stored.
If forecast cash is negative, inspect inputs; do not silently sell securities or alter real balances to repair the forecast.

result.zh: 预测起点是可用人民币银行现金，证券、房产、养老金不当现金；预留、已付与预付不重复扣。预测不生成交易。
result.en: Spendable CNY bank cash is the starting point. Securities, property, and pensions are not cash; reserves/payments/prepayments are not deducted twice. Forecasting posts nothing.

note.zh: 截图待补：S15含月报预测摘要，可识别实际/预计分层，但不是独立现金预测页或年度预算页的截图。
note.en: Screenshot gap: S15 includes a report forecast summary, not the separate forecast or annual-budget screen.

title.zh: 月报、不可变归档与ChatGPT复盘
title.en: Monthly reports, immutable archives, and ChatGPT review

entry.zh: 月度报告 → 月份/报告版本/保存本月报告
entry.en: 月度报告 (Monthly report) → month / version / save

prerequisite.zh: 已有本站记录；真实银行账单可能比本站范围更大。
prerequisite.en: Recorded app transactions; real bank history may extend beyond the app.

zh: 选择月份和“最新账目预览”，分别读确认收入、费用、现金净流量和净资产增减。
展开按成员/原币、关键流水与资产负债核对，检查开账、转账、证券本金和还贷本金的分类。
看实际积累与未入账周期预计，历史缺期初时保留提示，不把开账当收益。
核对后点“保存本月报告”；切换“报告版本”查看已保存第N版。
让ChatGPT按该月完整依据生成总结草稿；回站点核对，依据已变化时重新读取后生成，再采用。
en: Choose a month and 最新账目预览. Read income, expense, business cashflow, and net-worth change separately.
Expand member/original-currency details, key transactions, and asset/liability reconciliation; check opening balances, transfers, securities principal, and loan principal.
Separate actual accumulation from pending recurring forecasts and preserve unknown-opening-history warnings.
Choose 保存本月报告, then use 报告版本 to inspect an archived version.
Ask ChatGPT for a review grounded in the complete monthly context. If its basis changed, regenerate before adoption.

result.zh: 归档保存当时数据，不被后来补账改写；新预览/新版本可变化，旧版本不变。同月多版本年度汇总只能按选定规则取一份。
result.en: An archive preserves its original data. New previews/versions may change while earlier versions remain unchanged. Annual totals must not sum multiple versions of the same month.

note.zh: 保存报告不是生成银行对账单，月总结不改账。S13/S16为同月不同归档版本演示，不是一张图证明所有计算。
note.en: Saving a report does not create a bank statement; narrative reviews do not post. S13/S16 illustrate different archives, not complete calculation evidence.

title.zh: 会员权益、有效期与出行增量成本
title.en: Membership validity and incremental trip costs

entry.zh: 头像 → 会员权益；日历 → 会员权益
entry.en: Avatar or Calendar → 会员权益 (Membership benefits)

prerequisite.zh: 管理员维护，家人只读；不录卡号、证件或密码。
prerequisite.en: Administrator edits; members read. Never store card numbers, identity documents, or passwords.

zh: 点“新增会员权益”，填名称、品牌、种类、归属、已知等级、覆盖人数和可选已购成本。
选择未激活/已生效/待核实，填真实生效日期、平台明确到期日或有效天数，未知不勾“无固定到期日”。
逐条填权益、限制和额外费用，区分每人/每车/每次，记录价格依据与核对日期。
保存后按出行日期、种类、名称与归属筛选；停用时保留记录。
规划旅行前让ChatGPT读取会员，计算本次新增支出；未覆盖的人数、车辆、预约和餐饮另核价。
en: Choose 新增会员权益 and enter name, brand, type, owner, known tier, covered people, and optional historical cost.
Select activation status and actual start/platform expiry or duration. Do not mark “no expiry” simply because it is unknown.
Add benefits, restrictions, and extra charges with per-person/car/visit units, evidence type, and checked date.
Save and filter by travel date/type/name/owner; deactivate without deleting history.
Before planning, ask ChatGPT to read benefits and calculate incremental trip costs, including uncovered people, vehicles, reservations, and meals.

result.zh: 会员维护不扣银行、不生成资产或消费。已购成本不再次计入本次出游；未知酒店等级不猜折扣，推算有效期要标注。
result.en: Membership maintenance does not debit cash or create assets/expenses. Do not charge sunk purchase cost to a new trip. Unknown hotel tiers yield no invented discount; derived expiry is labeled.

note.zh: 截图待补：现有会员样本沿用旧个人购卡参数，不纳入公开演示。按C31独立构造权益后再采图。
note.en: Screenshot gap: existing membership samples reuse earlier personal purchase parameters and are excluded. Recapture with independent C31 inputs.

title.zh: 票据附件、重试、登出与常见故障
title.en: Attachments, retries, sign-out, and common recovery

entry.zh: 计划详情 → 票据与附件；顶部刷新/头像 → 退出登录
entry.en: Plan details → 票据与附件; refresh/avatar → sign out

prerequisite.zh: 附件加密已配置；仅使用演示文件。保存结果不明时先核查原请求。
prerequisite.en: Attachment encryption configured; demo files only. Resolve uncertain save results before retrying.

zh: 在计划详情选PDF/PNG/JPEG/WebP票据，核对预览、名称、大小与计划，明确勾选私密保存后提交。
单份不超过512KB、每计划最多20份；成功后核对列表和文件选择重置，再决定下一份。
提示已保存但列表刷新失败时先刷新；连接中断结果不明时检查原结果，不换文件后盲目重传。
版本冲突先重读，401重新登录，403检查家庭/角色；余额覆盖不明保留草稿，重复疑似项先查历史。
结束演示时隐藏金额并从头像“退出登录”；共享截图前检查姓名、金额、URL、邀请和附件内容。
en: Choose a PDF/PNG/JPEG/WebP in plan details, review its preview/name/size/plan, explicitly confirm private storage, then save.
Limits are512KB per file and20 per plan. After success inspect the list and cleared selection before the next file.
If saved but refresh failed, refresh first. For an interrupted unknown result, inspect the original request before changing files and resubmitting.
Re-read version conflicts, sign in after401, and check household/role after403. Keep uncertain balance coverage as a draft and investigate suspected duplicates.
Hide amounts and sign out via the avatar after the demo. Inspect names, amounts, URLs, invitations, and receipt content before sharing screenshots.

result.zh: 附件私密加密存储，与研究图片引用不同；归档附件保留历史。安全重试不应多存一份，预览不代表已上传成功。
result.en: Attachments are private encrypted files, separate from research image references. Archiving preserves history. Safe retries must not create extra files; a preview does not prove upload success.

note.zh: S17为隔离附件组件画面，不是生产上传证据。未配置密钥时停止保存并由部署维护者安全配置，不在聊天粘贴密钥。
note.en: S17 is an isolated attachment-component image, not production upload evidence. If encryption is unconfigured, stop and have the deployment maintainer configure it securely; never paste keys into chat.

title.zh: 已有余额开账不当收入
title.en: Opening balances are not income

data.zh: 独立空家庭A；演示银行A已有1000元，余额日D-1；D为演示当天。
data.en: Independent empty household A; demo bank A has CNY1,000 as of D-1; D is the demo date.

zh: 提交owned=true的已有资产草稿。
采用前查看正式账户；再在网站核对持有、成员和日期后采用。
查资产、现金流水和月报。
en: Submit an owned existing-asset draft.
Inspect formal accounts before adoption, then confirm ownership/member/date on the website.
Inspect assets, cashflow, and the monthly report.

expected.zh: 采用前不建正式资产；采用后银行1000元、开账记录存在，不多出1000元收入或第二次充值。
expected.en: No formal asset before adoption. Afterwards bank cash is1,000 with an opening record, not1,000 of income or a second top-up.

failure.zh: 把开账当工资收入，或已持有余额采用后翻倍。
failure.en: Opening counted as wages, or the existing balance doubled after adoption.

title.zh: 重复登记和重复采用
title.en: Duplicate registration and adoption

data.zh: C01已采用；保存原草稿ID与原请求。
data.en: C01 adopted; retain its draft ID and request.

zh: 重试同一采用请求。
读取原结果和账户数；再尝试把同一已有资产作为新草稿登记。
en: Retry the same adoption request.
Read the original result/account count, then attempt a second registration of the same holding.

expected.zh: 原请求不重复创建资产/分录；新的疑似重复登记需拒绝或核对，不能仅靠改名称绕过。
expected.en: The original request creates no additional asset/journal. A suspicious duplicate registration must be rejected or reviewed, not bypassed by renaming.

failure.zh: 第二账户、双倍余额或两份开账。
failure.en: A second account, doubled balance, or duplicate opening.

title.zh: 快照日期与未来实际
title.en: Snapshot dates and future actual events

data.zh: 银行余额日D-1；实际未覆盖的新付款10元；另准备D+1的未发生付款。
data.en: Bank snapshot D-1; an uncovered actual payment10; a separate unperformed payment on D+1.

zh: 用D记录已发生付款，核对日期与快照关系。
把日期改D+1或不匹配的已覆盖历史日期，尝试保存。
en: Record the actual event on D with correct snapshot coverage.
Attempt D+1 or a mismatched covered-history date.

expected.zh: 合法当前事实可核对；未来实际和覆盖冲突拒绝，银行不因失败变化。
expected.en: A valid actual event can be reviewed; future actuals and inconsistent coverage are rejected without cash changes.

failure.zh: 未来事件提前扣款，或历史跨快照二次扣。
failure.en: Premature debit or a second debit across a snapshot.

title.zh: 预算全流程不自动扣现
title.en: Budget lifecycle does not auto-debit cash

data.zh: 银行1000元；预算300元；两位有效登录成员。
data.en: Bank1,000; budget300; two active signed-in members.

zh: 提交预算草稿，回读。
网站采用并提交审批。
两人分别同意，再检查日历和银行。
en: Submit and read back a budget.
Adopt it for approval.
Have both members agree, then inspect calendar and cash.

expected.zh: 提交、采用、审批与排期后银行均1000元，实际流水无300元消费；全体同意后才出现正式计划。
expected.en: Cash stays1,000 throughout submission/adoption/approval/scheduling, with no300 expense. A formal plan appears only after all agree.

failure.zh: 预算一保存就少钱，或待批即当正式计划。
failure.en: Cash debited on budget save, or pending budget treated as formal.

title.zh: 本人逐人审批不能代签
title.en: Every member approves for themselves

data.zh: A管理员、B家人；300元待批预算。
data.en: Administrator A and member B; pending budget300.

zh: A核对并同意后读取B待审批。
A尝试指定B身份代同意；B再以自身账号确认。
en: After A agrees, inspect B’s pending approval.
Attempt to approve as B from A, then have B approve using their own identity.

expected.zh: A不能代B；B本人同意前不正式。身份来自服务器，不从参数指定。
expected.en: A cannot vote for B. The plan remains pending until B agrees; identity is server-derived.

failure.zh: 传入他人ID即能同意，或一票当全体同意。
failure.en: Client-specified identity votes, or one vote treated as unanimous.

title.zh: 变更预算重审和旧版拒绝
title.en: Budget edits require reapproval

data.zh: 已批准300元v1，修改为320元v2。
data.en: Approved300 version1, amended to320 version2.

zh: 通过原计划ID修改费用并采用新版。
用v1审批参数重试。
按v2重新完成全部成员确认。
en: Amend costs under the original plan ID and adopt.
Retry approval with v1 parameters.
Complete all approvals for v2.

expected.zh: 原计划ID不变；v1意见不批准v2，旧请求拒绝；新版未全同意前不能新增实际付款。
expected.en: Plan ID stays the same. Old opinions do not approve v2; stale requests fail, and new payments are blocked until renewed approval.

failure.zh: 改价沿用旧审批或另建一份正式计划。
failure.en: Old approval survives a price change, or a duplicate formal plan is created.

title.zh: 实际消费关联原预算
title.en: Link actual payment to its budget

data.zh: 已审批预算300元；银行1000元；真实已付120元，未含余额。
data.en: Approved budget300; bank1,000; actual uncovered payment120.

zh: 提交带原planId的120元cashflow草稿。
网站核对成员、账户、日期和未包含，确认实际付款后采用。
查看原计划、流水和银行。
en: Submit a120 cashflow draft linked to the original planId.
Confirm member/account/date/uncovered status and actual payment on the website.
Inspect the plan, transaction, and bank.

expected.zh: 草稿阶段银行1000；采用后银行880，恰好一笔关联原计划的付款，不能扣预算总额300。
expected.en: Cash remains1,000 at draft stage, then880 after adoption with exactly one linked payment; do not debit the300 budget.

failure.zh: 扣300、关联错计划、草稿提交已扣现。
failure.en: Debits300, links the wrong plan, or debits during draft submission.

title.zh: 已含余额历史不二扣
title.en: Covered history is not debited twice

data.zh: 银行快照余额1000元，日D-1已包括此前20元消费。
data.en: Bank snapshot1,000 on D-1 already covers a prior20 expense.

zh: 提交该历史流水，选择已包含并匹配snapshotDate。
网站采用；重读银行及历史业务金额。
再把覆盖日改错，尝试采用。
en: Submit the historical event as covered with the matching snapshot date.
Adopt and inspect bank balance and historical business amount.
Attempt an inconsistent coverage date.

expected.zh: 银行保持1000；记录历史消费20且本次现金变化0；错误覆盖拒绝。
expected.en: Cash stays1,000; historical expense20 is recorded with zero current cash movement. Inconsistent coverage is rejected.

failure.zh: 银行变980，或把历史金额也抹成0。
failure.en: Cash falls to980, or the historical business amount is erased.

title.zh: 实付—预付—消费—退款闭环
title.en: Payment–prepayment–consumption–refund cycle

data.zh: 独立银行1000元；批准预算300元；各步均D实际发生且不含快照。
data.en: Independent bank1,000; approved budget300; each event actually occurs on D and is not snapshot-covered.

zh: 直接付款120元。
预付款50元。
从该预付款确认消费30元。
将尚未消费20元退款记回原银行。
分别核对银行、预付资产和实际消费，重试同一消费请求。
en: Pay120 directly.
Prepay50.
Consume30 from that prepayment.
Refund the unused20 to the original bank.
Check cash/prepaid/consumption at each step and retry the same consumption request.

expected.zh: 银行依次880→830→830→850；预付资产0→50→20→0；最终实际消费150。重复消费不再扣现、不再冲预付。
expected.en: Cash880→830→830→850; prepaid asset0→50→20→0; final actual consumption150. Retry neither debits cash nor consumes prepaid funds twice.

failure.zh: 消费时再扣30、退已消费部分、退到别人的账户或重试重复消耗。
failure.en: Consumption debits cash again, consumed funds are refunded, refund goes elsewhere, or retry consumes twice.

title.zh: 响应丢失后安全重试
title.en: Safe retry after a lost response

data.zh: 1000元银行付款10元；原请求key已知。
data.en: Bank1,000 pays10; retain the original request key.

zh: 在隔离故障测试中模拟服务端成功但响应丢失。
先按原key查询结果，再重试同一个原请求。
检查账户、交易数与原回执。
en: In an isolated fault test, let the server succeed while dropping the response.
Query the original key, then retry the same request.
Inspect balance, transaction count, and receipt.

expected.zh: 最终银行990且一笔付款；结果不明不能直接换key新增。
expected.en: Final cash990 with one payment. An uncertain result is not permission to create a new key.

failure.zh: 多扣一次、自动生成新key重放或只凭页面无提示判失败。
failure.en: Second debit, silent replay with a new key, or treating missing UI feedback as definite failure.

title.zh: 余额不足全回滚
title.en: Insufficient funds roll back completely

data.zh: 银行50元；尝试实际付款60元或买入50元另收1元费。
data.en: Bank50; try payment60 or a purchase50 plus fee1.

zh: 提交并确认该操作。
比较操作前后账户、计划、交易和审计业务状态。
en: Submit and confirm the operation.
Compare accounts, plan, transactions, and business audit state before/after.

expected.zh: 拒绝；现金仍50，无半笔分录、无新持仓、无错误已付状态。
expected.en: Reject; cash remains50 with no partial journal, new holding, or false paid status.

failure.zh: 银行负数、先建资产后报错或计划已付但流水没有。
failure.en: Negative cash, orphan holding, or paid plan without a transaction.

title.zh: 取消保留实际款项与安全刷新
title.en: Cancellation preserves actuals and recovers refresh

data.zh: 批准计划有20元实际付款、30元未消费预付。
data.en: An approved plan has20 paid and30 unused prepaid.

zh: 取消当前计划版本。
查看正常列表、显示已取消和原流水。
模拟取消成功后刷新失败，再刷新核对。
en: Cancel the current version.
Inspect normal/cancelled views and original transactions.
Simulate successful cancellation with failed refresh, then refresh again.

expected.zh: 未用预算预留释放；20付款和30预付历史不删除；取消不自动退款，也不因刷新失败再次取消。已有预付按实际消费/退款结算。
expected.en: Unused reserves release;20 paid and30 prepaid history remain. No automatic refund or repeat cancellation; existing prepaid funds remain settleable by actual consumption/refund.

failure.zh: 取消恢复现金、删除付款，或结果已成功却重放写入。
failure.en: Cancellation invents cash, deletes payments, or replays a successful write.

title.zh: 家庭隔离覆盖读取与写入
title.en: Household isolation on reads and writes

data.zh: 家庭A/B各有独立演示账号，A有私密计划与账户。
data.en: Separate demo households A/B; A owns a private plan and account.

zh: 用B打开A计划链接、猜账户ID并访问财务、报告、附件及MCP。
尝试提交对A资源的草稿或写入。
用未登录身份重测读取。
en: As B, open A’s plan URL and request A’s account/finance/report/attachment/MCP data.
Attempt drafts or writes referencing A’s resources.
Repeat reads anonymously.

expected.zh: 无A的名称、金额、票据或记录泄露，写入拒绝；未认证通常401，已认证无权通常403或不暴露资源的响应。
expected.en: No A names, amounts, receipts, or records leak; writes fail. Anonymous access normally gets401; unauthorized authenticated access gets403 or a nonrevealing response.

failure.zh: 知道ID就能读、MCP绕过家庭范围、错误信息携带余额。
failure.en: ID knowledge grants access, MCP bypasses scope, or errors leak balances.

title.zh: 只读成员仅提交本人意见
title.en: Read-only members submit only their own opinion

data.zh: 家人B只读，但在待批预算成员集中。
data.en: Member B is read-only and included in the pending approval set.

zh: B读家庭并尝试改资产、规则、目标、采用草稿及修改会员。
B打开预算并提交自己的同意。
en: As B, read the household and attempt financial/rule/goal/draft/membership changes.
Submit B’s own budget opinion.

expected.zh: 一般写入拒绝；本人预算意见允许。不能因为只读而取消其本人投票，也不能因可投票开放财务写入。
expected.en: General writes fail while B’s own opinion succeeds. Voting permission neither disappears with read-only status nor expands into financial write access.

failure.zh: 审批权限与一般写入混用。
failure.en: Approval and general-write permissions are conflated.

title.zh: 移除成员使旧会话与在途写入失效
title.en: Removal revokes stale sessions and in-flight writes

data.zh: B已加载家庭；准备在写入前由A移除B。
data.en: B has loaded the household; A removes B before commit.

zh: B保留旧页面和请求版本。
A移除B，B刷新、查询与提交旧写入。
隔离测试将移除插在读取与最终提交之间。
en: Keep B’s stale page/request.
Remove B, then retry refresh/read/write.
In an isolated test, remove membership between initial read and final commit.

expected.zh: 撤销权限后后续读取/最终写入拒绝，不能靠旧快照继续；既有历史和原归属保留。
expected.en: Subsequent reads/final writes fail after revocation; stale snapshots grant nothing. Prior history/ownership remain.

failure.zh: 仅页面隐藏但旧请求仍可保存，或移除时删历史资产。
failure.en: UI hides data but stale requests still save, or removal deletes assets.

title.zh: 邀请生命周期与最后管理员
title.en: Invitation lifecycle and administrator transfer

data.zh: 独立邀请链接，仅在隔离环境测试。
data.en: Independent invitation tokens used only in isolation.

zh: 正常接受一次后再次使用；另测撤销、过期与错误token。
已在别家身份尝试加入；当前管理员尝试直接退出。
转移管理给有效成员再退出。
en: Accept once, reuse, then test revoked/expired/invalid tokens.
Try joining from another existing household and direct administrator departure.
Transfer management to an active member before leaving.

expected.zh: 邀请不可重复/撤销后不可用；不误合并家庭；不能留下无管理员家庭；不改变个人资产所有权。
expected.en: No token reuse or revoked access, no accidental household merge, no ownerless household, and no asset ownership transfer.

failure.zh: 重复加入、撤销无效、转管理顺带转资产。
failure.en: Reuse, ineffective revocation, or asset ownership moving with management.

title.zh: 记账档案不授予登录权限
title.en: Bookkeeping profiles grant no sign-in access

data.zh: 新增昵称“演示成员乙”，尚无登录账号关联。
data.en: New nickname “Demo member B”, without a linked sign-in identity.

zh: 保存昵称并给演示资产设置归属。
检查家庭登录成员与预算投票名单。
随后显式关联已加入账号，核对历史归属。
en: Save the nickname and assign demo asset ownership.
Inspect signed-in members and approval voters.
Explicitly link an existing household identity and inspect historical ownership.

expected.zh: 仅有昵称不会发邀请、授予读取或增加投票人；关联按规则保留历史，不凭同名自动合并资产。
expected.en: A nickname sends no invitation, grants no read access, and adds no voter. Explicit linkage preserves history without name-based automatic asset merging.

failure.zh: 建昵称即能登录/投票，或关联偷偷转归属。
failure.en: Nickname grants login/voting, or linking silently changes ownership.

title.zh: 同ID续改、双版本与已处理只读
title.en: Same-ID amendment, version checks, processed immutability

data.zh: PENDING预算草稿v1；保留原request_id与全局版本。
data.en: Pending budget draft v1; retain its request/global version.

zh: 回读后以同ID、同类型完整替换payload。
用旧draftVersion或旧全局revision重试；尝试改planId或类型。
采用后再尝试原地续改。
en: Read back and replace the complete payload under the same ID/type.
Retry stale draft/global versions and attempt changing planId/type.
Attempt amendment after adoption.

expected.zh: 合法续改版本递增、回读一致；旧版本、关联更换与已处理续改拒绝，不产生第二份草稿。
expected.en: Valid updates increment versions and read back consistently. Stale versions, reassociation, and processed edits fail without creating a duplicate.

failure.zh: 丢字段、误改关联、旧稿覆盖新稿或采纳后重写历史。
failure.en: Dropped fields, changed associations, stale overwrite, or edited processed history.

title.zh: 类型性质、引用与停用边界
title.en: Asset-type nature, references, and disabling

data.zh: 自定义银行性质类型“演示备用金”，被账户或目标引用。
data.en: Custom cash-nature type “Demo reserve” referenced by an account or goal.

zh: 改显示名称后读余额。
尝试将性质改为股票或停用仍被引用的类型。
移除合法引用后再按允许规则维护。
en: Rename and inspect balances.
Attempt switching accounting nature to stock or disabling a referenced type.
After removing legitimate references, perform allowed maintenance.

expected.zh: 改名不改账；性质固定，引用中的类型不能停用，跨家庭类型ID拒绝。
expected.en: Renaming does not post. Nature is fixed, referenced types cannot be disabled, and foreign household IDs fail.

failure.zh: 改名改变账务性质、旧持仓变现金或停用破坏目标。
failure.en: Renaming changes accounting, holdings become cash, or disabling breaks goals.

title.zh: 目标单位、自由组合与去重
title.en: Goal units, combinations, and deduplication

data.zh: 演示现金1000元、其他类型200元；现金目标2000元。
data.en: Demo cash1,000 and another type200; cash-only goal2,000.

zh: 只勾现金并保存目标2000元。
读取完成额和进度，再把同一类型选进第二目标。
新增一个类型，检查是否自动进原目标。
en: Save a2,000 goal selecting cash only.
Read current value/progress, then select cash in another goal.
Create a new type and check the original goal scope.

expected.zh: 当前1000元、进度50%，不是按分误读或把其他200元也算入；重复范围拒绝，新类别不自动加入。
expected.en: Current1,000 and progress50%; no minor-unit scaling error or inclusion of the other200. Duplicate scope fails; new types are not added automatically.

failure.zh: 100倍/10000倍金额错误、范围交叉、未选资产冒充完成额。
failure.en: Scaling errors, overlapping scopes, or unselected assets inflating progress.

title.zh: 买入加费用与清仓净回款
title.en: Purchase plus fees and liquidation net proceeds

data.zh: 银行1000元；新演示基金买300元、费5元、3份；后全部卖330元、费5元。
data.en: Bank1,000; buy demo fund300 plus fee5,3 units; later liquidate330 minus fee5.

zh: 首次实际买入并查看现金、持仓及交易种类。
清仓时核对全部3份与账面，再确认净到账。
显示清零账户并重试原清仓。
en: Record the first purchase and inspect cash/holding/type.
Liquidate the complete3 units after checking the carrying amount.
Show cleared accounts and retry the same sale.

expected.zh: 银行1000→695→1020；买入为真实交易而非开账；清仓持仓清零但历史存在，重试不再加325元。
expected.en: Cash1,000→695→1,020. Purchase is a trade, not an opening. Liquidation clears holdings while preserving history; retry does not credit another325.

failure.zh: 忘手续费、清仓回账面金额代成交、删除历史或重复到账。
failure.en: Missing fees, crediting carrying value instead of proceeds, deleted history, or duplicate cash.

title.zh: 成员、币种和家庭账户错配
title.en: Member, currency, and household mismatches

data.zh: 人民币持仓、美元银行、另一成员现金与另一家庭账户。
data.en: A CNY holding, USD bank, mismatched member cash, and a foreign household account.

zh: 分别用错币种、错成员或外国账户ID记录买卖/充值/付款。
检查错误前后所有相关余额。
en: Attempt trades/contributions/payments with a wrong currency/member or foreign account ID.
Compare all balances before/after rejection.

expected.zh: 错配拒绝且全回滚，不自动换汇、不猜现金归属、不跨家庭写。
expected.en: Reject and roll back mismatches; no automatic FX, guessed ownership, or cross-household writes.

failure.zh: 悄悄替换付款账户或隐式换汇。
failure.en: Silent account substitution or implicit FX conversion.

title.zh: 还贷模拟与实际本息分离
title.en: Loan simulation versus actual principal and interest

data.zh: 银行1000元、贷款本金5000元；实际还本金100元、息10元。
data.en: Bank1,000; loan principal5,000; actual principal repayment100 plus interest10.

zh: 运行两种提前还贷模拟并保存未来预算，检查余额。
银行实际发生后记录本金100和利息10。
检查银行、贷款、月报与剩余备款。
en: Run both simulation modes and save a future budget; inspect balances.
After actual payment record principal100 and interest10.
Inspect cash, debt, report, and remaining funding.

expected.zh: 模拟/预算不改余额；实际后现金890、贷款4900；本金不是费用，利息10另列。
expected.en: Simulation/budget leave balances untouched. Actual cash890, debt4,900; principal is not expense and interest10 is separate.

failure.zh: 模拟扣款、110全减本金、100本金计消费或部分还款误关计划。
failure.en: Simulation posts, all110 reduces principal, principal becomes expense, or partial payment closes the plan.

title.zh: 未来首期、暂停与规则合计
title.en: Future first occurrence, pause, and rule totals

data.zh: 100元月收入，首期D+1；另有暂停规则。
data.en: Recurring income100, first occurrence D+1; another paused rule.

zh: 保存后看常规月合计与本月排期。
D前检查到期，再暂停并检查。
对照月报实际与预计。
en: Compare regular rule totals with month-specific schedules.
Check due items before D+1, then pause and check again.
Compare actual versus forecast in the report.

expected.zh: 常规月卡可显示启用规则，但首期之前不生成实际；暂停不生成新的到期项；不补历史收入。
expected.en: An active rule may contribute to regular totals but posts no actual before its first date. Paused rules create no new due items and no historical income is invented.

failure.zh: 首期未来却提前增现金，或规则月合计当已到账。
failure.en: Cash increases before the first date, or regular totals are treated as receipts.

title.zh: 同月改扣款日不重复执行
title.en: Changing the day does not duplicate a monthly occurrence

data.zh: 同一月规则已有待核实或已确认事项。
data.en: The rule already has a due or confirmed occurrence in the same month.

zh: 把每月日期改为本月另一天。
再次检查到期、确认或补执行，并重试原请求。
en: Move the monthly day to another date in the same month.
Recheck due items/confirmation/catch-up and retry.

expected.zh: 同规则同月份不能生成第二笔业务；已确认金额从待预计中移除，不重复加实际或预计。
expected.en: No second business occurrence for the same rule/month. Confirmed amounts leave remaining forecasts without double-counting either actuals or forecasts.

failure.zh: 改日期造两笔工资或同一还贷重复扣。
failure.en: A moved date creates duplicate wages or repayment.

title.zh: 月度收入、费用、现金与净值分开
title.en: Separate income, expense, cashflow, and net worth

data.zh: 独立演示开账；收入200、消费50、还贷本金100息10，另有内部转账。
data.en: Independent demo opening; income200, expense50, loan principal100/interest10, plus an internal transfer.

zh: 按真实专用入口分别记录。
打开月报与总览实际积累，展开原币和成员。
再增加未发生周期收入，比较预计。
en: Record each event using its correct flow.
Open the report/actual accumulation and inspect member/currency details.
Add a pending recurring income and compare forecasts.

expected.zh: 业务收入200、消费/利息费用60；还贷本金不是费用，开账/转账不当收入，未发生收入不混实际。现金变化与净资产变化可不同。
expected.en: Business income200 and consumption/interest expense60. Loan principal is not expense; openings/transfers are not income; pending income is forecast only. Cash and net-worth changes may differ.

failure.zh: 净资产增加全当收益，或贷款本金当生活费并重扣。
failure.en: All asset growth called returns, or loan principal treated as living expense and deducted twice.

title.zh: 归档不可变与总结依据过期
title.en: Immutable archive and stale review basis

data.zh: 某月已保存v1；准备一份以旧指纹为依据的总结。
data.en: Saved monthly archive v1; review draft based on an older fingerprint.

zh: 补一笔该月真实演示支出。
对比最新预览、v1与新保存v2。
尝试采用旧指纹总结，再重读生成新稿。
en: Add a demo expense in the same month.
Compare live preview, v1, and new archive v2.
Attempt adoption with the stale review fingerprint, then regenerate from fresh context.

expected.zh: v1不变，新预览/v2反映新分录；旧总结拒绝或要求重读，年度不把v1+v2重复累计。
expected.en: v1 remains unchanged; live/v2 reflect the new journal. Stale review adoption fails or requires refresh. Annual totals do not add both versions.

failure.zh: 新流水改写v1、旧总结无提示继续用或年度重复。
failure.en: A new transaction rewrites v1, stale prose silently passes, or annual totals duplicate versions.

title.zh: 完整分页与版本一致性
title.en: Complete pagination with consistent versions

data.zh: 超过单页上限的演示流水，夹有不匹配筛选行。
data.en: Demo history larger than one page, including rows outside the filter.

zh: 固定筛选及版本读第一页并沿nextCursor读到complete=true。
空筛选页仍检查nextCursor。
在翻页间新增分录或改家庭成员，再用旧版本继续。
en: Hold filters/versions constant and follow nextCursor until complete=true.
Check cursors even on an empty filtered page.
Change ledger/membership between pages and continue with stale versions.

expected.zh: 不中途漏页、不把最近几条当完整银行历史；版本冲突从首页重读，月报/周期归并不能混两个版本。
expected.en: No skipped pages or claims that recent rows represent full bank history. Restart after conflicts; reports/recurring analysis must not mix versions.

failure.zh: 空页即结束、汇总最近100条、旧新页混算。
failure.en: Stop on an empty page, sum only recent100 rows, or mix versions.

title.zh: 养老金内部交易不当外部充值
title.en: Pension internal trading is not external contribution

data.zh: 普通银行1000；养老金现金200、产品0；演示年度额度已满。
data.en: Ordinary bank1,000; pension cash200, products0; demo annual allowance already exhausted.

zh: 账户内买产品100，费0。
全部赎回净额110。
用内部资金再买产品50，费0，读取银行及年度实缴。
en: Buy internally for100 with zero fee.
Redeem completely for net110.
Reinvest50 internally and read ordinary cash/contributions.

expected.en: Pension cash200→100→210→160, products0→100→0→50, total200→200→210→210. Ordinary cash stays1,000 and annual contributions do not change.

failure.zh: 额度满禁止内部投资、赎回进普通银行或账户总额加底层双算。
failure.en: Exhausted allowance blocks internal investment, redemption credits ordinary cash, or totals double-count products.

title.zh: 养老金不能借快照或归属解锁
title.en: Pension restrictions survive snapshots and ownership edits

data.zh: 有确认缴费及内部交易的演示养老金。
data.en: Demo pension with confirmed contributions and internal trades.

zh: 尝试删实缴重开额度、改成普通类型、转归属或借成员别名合并。
提交早于最近交易的快照；将个人计划年龄当自动解锁。
en: Attempt to clear contributions, change to an ordinary type, transfer ownership, or merge through aliases.
Submit a snapshot older than the last trade and treat a planned age as automatic unlocking.

expected.zh: 绕过拒绝，余额/缴费/归属/历史保持；分类维护不能变成提款。
expected.en: Reject bypasses while preserving balances, contributions, ownership, and history. Classification is not withdrawal.

failure.zh: 改一个字段即可提现或覆盖新交易事实。
failure.en: One field unlocks withdrawal or overwrites newer facts.

title.zh: 会员有效期、人数及增量成本
title.en: Membership validity, party coverage, incremental cost

data.zh: 独立演示双人年卡，已购成本600元；3位成人；额外车费40元为待核价参考。
data.en: Independent demo two-person pass, sunk cost600; party of3 adults; extra vehicle fee40 is an unverified reference.

zh: 按演示日期保存权益，再分别选有效、过期、未激活和停用日期/状态。
让规划读取权益，列出覆盖2人、第三人和车费的待核事项。
en: Save benefits and test valid/expired/unactivated/disabled date/status combinations.
Have planning read them and list covered2 people, the third person, and vehicle charge evidence.

expected.zh: 600不再加为本次新增消费，不因维护扣银行；未覆盖人和车费仍列，未知票价不填0；过期权益不冒充优惠。
expected.en: Do not add600 again to this trip or debit cash for maintenance. List the uncovered person/vehicle charge; unknown tickets are not free and expired benefits provide no assumed discount.

failure.zh: 重复算购卡成本、默认全员免费、凭未知酒店等级给折扣。
failure.en: Sunk cost charged again, everyone assumed free, or an unknown hotel tier invents a discount.

title.zh: 报价、旧快照和缺汇率不改账
title.en: Quotes, snapshots, and missing FX do not post

data.zh: 演示证券有存储数量/单价/账面；另有缺汇率外币账户。
data.en: Demo securities have stored quantity/price/carrying value; another account lacks FX.

zh: 刷新最新可用行情，模拟过期、失败或币种不符。
比较存储快照算术与新参考市值。
查看汇总和当前现金。
en: Refresh quotes with stale/failure/currency-mismatch responses.
Compare stored-snapshot arithmetic with new indicative market value.
Inspect totals and cash.

expected.zh: 保留原快照、来源时间和未折算提示，不默认为1:1，不把参考价格当成交或现金，不自动补差调账。
expected.en: Preserve stored snapshots, timestamps, and unconverted warnings. No default1:1 FX, execution-price claim, cash conversion, or balancing entry.

failure.zh: 刷新行情改真实持仓/余额，或缺汇率仍给完整净值。
failure.en: Quote refresh changes booked balances, or missing FX produces a false complete total.

title.zh: 隐私默认隐藏但编辑值仍敏感
title.en: Privacy defaults hide display, not edit values

data.zh: 独立演示家庭，含金额与长说明。
data.en: Independent demo household with amounts and explanatory prose.

zh: 首次进入检查主卡、列表、说明和研究。
显示金额、跨栏目、再刷新。
打开编辑/核对表单，检查原值提示并避免共享。
en: Inspect cards/lists/prose/research on first load.
Reveal, navigate, then reload.
Open edit/review forms and check the original-value warning before sharing.

expected.zh: 刷新默认隐藏、页面内选择按设计保留，敏感展示不漏在说明中；表单原值不是安全脱敏。
expected.en: Reload hides values; in-page preference behaves consistently and explanatory prose does not leak amounts. Original values in forms are not redacted data.

failure.zh: 上次显示状态持久化成默认明文，或小字/提示漏金额。
failure.en: Reveal preference becomes the next default, or small print leaks amounts.

title.zh: 附件上传成功、失败与未知结果
title.en: Attachment upload success, failure, uncertain result

data.zh: 独立计划，合成1KB PDF；原请求key固定。
data.en: Independent plan, synthetic1KB PDF, fixed request key.

zh: 预览但不确认，检查尚未存储；确认后保存并看清空选择。
模拟保存成功但刷新失败，以及响应丢失后重试。
换文件前核对原请求状态；测试伪装类型、超限和跨家庭下载。
en: Preview without consent, then consent/save and inspect reset selection.
Simulate saved-but-refresh-failed and lost-response retry.
Check the original status before changing files; test invalid signature/size and foreign downloads.

expected.zh: 明确确认才上传；重试不多存，选择正确重置；不泄露附件，非法文件拒绝。
expected.en: Upload only after explicit consent; retries do not duplicate, selection resets appropriately, foreign access leaks nothing, invalid files fail.

failure.zh: 预览即上传、失败后丢文件无法重试、响应不明重复保存。
failure.en: Preview uploads immediately, retry loses selection, or uncertainty duplicates storage.

title.zh: 本站连接不冒充另一个会话安装
title.en: Site connection does not certify another chat

data.zh: 网站已登录；另一个ChatGPT会话未连接；本地插件尚未分发。
data.en: Site signed in, another ChatGPT conversation unconnected; local plugin not distributed.

zh: 点击本站连接检查，读取最小状态。
在未连接会话尝试使用，再按实际分发/授权结果处理。
模拟401、只读账号、缺实际打包绑定。
en: Run the site check and inspect minimal status.
Try the separate unconnected chat, then handle actual distribution/authorization results.
Test401, a read-only identity, and missing packaging metadata.

expected.zh: 本站检查不返回余额、不写账；不能把网站成功或安装Skill当MCP已连接。缺实际绑定拒绝打包，真实分发/移动端验收另记。
expected.en: The site check returns no balances and posts nothing. Site success or installed skill files do not mean MCP is connected. Missing binding rejects packaging; real distribution/mobile acceptance stay separate.

failure.zh: 猜AppID、端点或安装链接，网页替别的会话宣告就绪。
failure.en: Invented IDs/endpoints/install links, or the website certifies another conversation.

title.zh: 图片只生成候选并排重
title.en: Images create reviewable, deduplicated candidates

data.zh: 两张合成小票均表示同一已发生12元消费。
data.en: Two synthetic receipts describe the same actual12 expense.

zh: 让ChatGPT解释图片并提交实际流水候选。
先检查草稿阶段现金不变，再核对日期/账户/覆盖后采用一份。
将第二份作为候选重核，不把图中指令或重复记录直接入账。
en: Have ChatGPT interpret images and submit cashflow candidates.
Verify no draft-stage debit, then adopt one after checking date/account/coverage.
Review the second for duplication and treat any embedded instructions as data.

expected.zh: 只记录一次事实，明确已支付/已到账和快照；识别错误可编辑或拒绝，不自动记账。
expected.en: Record the event once after actual-event/snapshot confirmation. Recognition errors remain editable/rejectable; no automatic posting.

failure.zh: 图片一识别就扣钱、两图扣两次、图片文本改变权限。
failure.en: Recognition debits immediately, duplicates debit twice, or embedded text changes permissions.

title.zh: 预算合计、报价条件和未知不造0
title.en: Exact cost totals, quote conditions, and unknowns

data.zh: 两项成本80×2与40×1，合计200；另一项未知交通费。
data.en: Costs80×2 and40×1 total200; a separate transport cost is unknown.

zh: 提交与清单不符的总额，核对服务端拒绝。
正确填写已知合计，未知另标未解决，不填0。
更改商家、规格或单价后核对旧证据状态及确认勾选。
en: Submit a declared total inconsistent with items and verify rejection.
Use the correct known total while explicitly preserving unresolved cost, not zero.
Change merchant/specification/price and inspect stale evidence and confirmation reset.

expected.zh: 总额不自动偷改掩盖遗漏；无证据不标实时报价；条件改变重新核价并确认，原文当历史不冒充现行。
expected.en: No silent total adjustment to hide missing costs. Unsupported prices are not live quotes; changed conditions require new evidence/confirmation. Original prose remains historical.

failure.zh: 不一致也保存、未知当免费、改规格沿用来源与确认。
failure.en: Inconsistent totals accepted, unknown treated as free, or changed specs retain old evidence/consent.

title.zh: 投资研究与复核不执行交易
title.en: Research and follow-up do not trade

data.zh: 演示投资结论及一条D+1复核安排，原持仓与现金已知。
data.en: Demo investment research and a D+1 follow-up, with known initial holdings/cash.

zh: 保存并采用investment草稿。
调整复核日期/条件并同步日历。
比较持仓、现金、预算和流水，再取消复核。
en: Save/adopt an investment draft.
Adjust its follow-up date/conditions and sync to the calendar.
Compare holdings/cash/budgets/transactions, then cancel the follow-up.

expected.zh: 只有研究和复核元数据改变，标明未交易；不能因“建议买入”新增持仓、扣银行或建消费预算。
expected.en: Only research/follow-up metadata changes, labeled unexecuted. A buy recommendation creates no holding, debit, or spending budget.

failure.zh: 研究采用即成交、取消复核反向改持仓。
failure.en: Adoption executes a trade, or cancelling a reminder reverses holdings.

title.zh: 同币种内部转账不当收入
title.en: Same-currency transfers are not income

data.zh: 银行A1000元、B500元，均CNY；已发生A→B200元。
data.en: CNY bank A1,000 and B500; completed transfer A→B200.

zh: 从A行内部转账选择B及对应成员，记录200元。
检查两边余额、总现金和月报，重试原请求。
en: Record200 from A to B with the correct members.
Inspect both balances, total cash/report, then retry.

expected.zh: A800、B700，总现金1500不变；有双方记录，不当收入或消费，重试不重复。
expected.en: A800, B700, total1,500 unchanged; both sides are traceable, no income/consumption, no duplicate on retry.

failure.zh: 一边变更、转账当收益、跨币种暗换汇。
failure.en: Only one side changes, transfer becomes income, or hidden FX occurs.

title.zh: 清零归档保留历史与重新持有
title.en: Clearing/archiving preserves history and re-entry

data.zh: 一份已全部卖出的演示持仓，保留原买卖流水。
data.en: A fully sold demo holding with its original transactions.

zh: 确认普通持有列表隐藏，勾“显示清零与归档账户”。
查旧持仓/交易；允许时对同账户重新买入。
尝试归档非零资产或删除历史。
en: Check default hiding and enable the cleared/archived view.
Inspect original trades and, when allowed, buy into the same account again.
Attempt archiving nonzero assets or deleting history.

expected.zh: 历史不删除，正常重买不伪造第二份开账；未满足归档条件拒绝，旧交易仍可追溯。
expected.en: History remains; re-entry is a trade, not another invented opening. Invalid archiving fails and old transactions remain traceable.

failure.zh: 清仓删流水、重买丢成本历史、归档抹非零资产。
failure.en: Liquidation deletes records, re-entry loses history, or archiving erases a balance.
